rationale: Builds on the staged reverse-tail best with a compact runtime patch: during the late quant-aware phase, the first recurrent tail pass is softly blended toward the full final-eval gain instead of jumping to full recurrence. It also keeps logit calibration controls as FP32 passthrough tensors for negligible export cost, while preserving VAL_LOSS_EVERY=0 and the exact final int8+zlib marker path.
title: Soft Quant-Aware Tail-Gain Blend
